description_en: Queries the real-time traffic of a user by traffic type
description_zh: 查看用户不同类型的实时流量
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-traffic --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --start-timestamp 1665331200 --end-timestamp 1665386280 --type qps --interval 3600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-ae0000000i --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserTraffic

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The type of real-time user traffic. Valid values:
- bot: the number of bot management requests.
- risk: the number of times risk identification is triggered.
- custom_acl_captcha: the number of times the slider action of custom rules is triggered.
- qps: the peak QPS.
- apisec: the number of API security requests.
- alb: the number of requests connected through ALB.
- mse: the number of requests connected through MSE.
- fc: the number of requests connected through Function Compute.
- sae: the number of requests connected through Serverless App Engine.
- apig: the number of requests connected through Cloud Native API Gateway.
- nlb: the number of requests connected through NLB
parameters.help_zh:
用户实时流量的类型，取值：
- bot：Bot管理请求数。
- risk：触发风险识别的次数。
- custom_acl_captcha：触发自定义规则滑块动作的次数。
- qps：QPS峰值。
- apisec：API安全请求数。
- alb: ALB接入的请求数。
- mse: MSE接入的请求数。
- fc: 函数计算接入的请求数。
- sae: 应用引擎接入的请求数。
- apig: 云原生API网关接入的请求数。
- nlb: NLB接入的请求数
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
